title: The wedge product is an area
caption: (2e₁ + 3e₂) ∧ (e₁ + 4e₂) = (8 − 3) e₁ ∧ e₂ = 5 e₁ ∧ e₂: the coefficient 5 is the area of the parallelogram the two vectors span, which is also det [[2, 1], [3, 4]].
alt: A parallelogram with sides (2, 3) and (1, 4) from the origin, vertices (0, 0), (2, 3), (3, 7), (1, 4), and area 5.
description: The vectors a = (2, 3) and b = (1, 4) are two sides from the origin.
Completing the parallelogram gives the fourth vertex (3, 7).
Its area is 2 × 4 − 3 × 1 = 5, the coefficient of e₁ ∧ e₂.
